title: A variadic parameter that is not the last one compiles without an error.
text: `public static function rest(int ...$xs, int $last)` passes `nvs check`. `MethodSig::variadic` reads only `m.params.last()`, so the `...` on an earlier parameter is ignored: the method takes exactly one `int` for `$xs`, and `rest(1, 2, 3)` is `E0402` ("expected 2 argument(s)"). The chapter and the syntax page say only the last parameter can be variadic. It closes when a `...` on any parameter but the last is a diagnostic at that parameter, with a conformance case.
